reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001242 (the melody read from 001242a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Henry John Gauntlett's dates (1805–1876) are from our page for the tune IRBY (content/hymns/tunes/irby.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1848. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001242a.nwc). The tune ends on E, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
